principle: Preserve complete, uncapped evidence. This is a Git storage gate, never an evidence-completeness exception.
expectedTotalEstimate: 15-40 MB for primary plus repeat, extrapolated from the committed 15-case baseline

gate.atOrBelow100MB: commit the raw evidence according to the governed plan
gate.above100MB: complete the run and preserve the workflow artifact, but STOP before committing raw evidence to Git, and report

reportedEitherWay: bytes by category: pass records, word records, line records, candidate records, manifests
ifTheGateFires: The evidence still exists in full as a workflow artifact. Only its commitment to Git is withheld, and that fact is reported rather than resolved by shrinking the evidence.
